scope: Read-only independent verification of the fixed metadata screening analysis; only this review report was written. No API, pretrained model, world-model forward, environment, GPU or new baseline search.

checks.name: saved_prediction_reconstruction
checks.detail: Independently reconstructed all 2898 saved predictions from the training manifest using categorical counts, Laplace pseudocounts and train-only global fallback; absolute errors below 1e-15. No original analysis main() rerun.

checks.name: auc_definition
checks.detail: Independently used sorted score groups and negative-below counts to reproduce all six AUCs exactly. RSWT is pooled hijack-versus-legitimate AUC; Harm is pooled hijack-versus-benign-misplace AUC. Both use half credit for ties. Neither is donor pair accuracy.

checks.name: donor_pair_metric
checks.detail: Verified 222 donors, exactly one hijack and one legitimate record per donor, and independently reproduced all three pair-order accuracies with half credit for ties.

checks.name: predictor_feature_boundary
checks.detail: The three configured feature sets contain only base_action, base_app, and clipped floor(10*step_frac). No cls, label, donor, attack category, sid, pair_id, observed/clean transition reference or other prohibited construction field enters predictions. cls supplies supervised training labels and metric grouping; donor_id only groups evaluation pairs.

checks.name: training_test_boundary
checks.detail: Cell frequencies and fallback are computed only from 6786 training rows; test labels do not enter fitting. Independently confirmed zero train/test transition-ID and episode-prefix overlap for base, obs, clean and the union across roles. This is not a pixel-deduplication or statistical-independence certificate.

checks.name: configured_estimator
checks.detail: The binary target is 1_hijack versus all other classes, matching the native harm-head target. Positive smoothing is (cell_positive+1)/(cell_total+2). Unseen cells use (2500+1)/(6786+2)=0.3684443134944019, with no test-time refit.

checks.name: followup_gate
checks.detail: Every configured RSWT/Harm point estimate is below the fixed 0.90 threshold. No sign inversion, extra feature group or tuned threshold was introduced in this review.

checks.name: execution_scope
checks.detail: The reviewed baseline script imports standard-library modules only and contains no model/API/environment/GPU execution. This source audit does not independently reconstruct all historical process activity.

app_action_unseen_cell_analysis.interpretation: The reported app-action AUC includes every unseen row at the global training prior; rows were not dropped or backfilled using test labels. Coverage is uneven across classes and sources, so 0.82818 RSWT should not be interpreted as transfer of an app-specific detector to all test apps. No alternative fallback was evaluated.

interpretation.supported: These three fixed train-only metadata baselines do not pass the registered screening gate. App-action metadata yields a moderate RSWT point estimate but approximately chance Harm discrimination on this fixed test set.
not_supported: No claim that the trained LGWM verifier uses metadata shortcuts or that its integrity or harm-head metrics are invalid.
No conclusion that richer learned context-only representations cannot explain benchmark performance.
No deployment detector, false-negative operating point, attack success, security injury or environment consequence is measured.
No significance or population-generalization claim is warranted by these point estimates.
The additive harm-head representational observation remains separate; this metadata screening result neither proves nor removes that architectural limitation.

limitations: The test manifest structure was inspected before the fixed baseline protocol; treat this as development screening, not blind confirmatory testing.
The recorded protocol timing is consistent with the supplied account but cannot be independently established from current file contents alone.
base_app and normalized step_frac are dataset metadata, not demonstrated runtime inputs. step_frac may require episode-length information unavailable online.
The native training set contains paired hijack/safe contexts and is imbalanced; matching its target does not make these categorical estimators equivalent to the learned residual head.
ID overlap checks do not establish visual deduplication, semantic independence or absence of pretraining overlap.
Report hashes bind this review to current files; no saved executed-script snapshot was supplied for independent historical version verification.
